Subject: Assessment sample lifecycle & handshake — delivery schedule, access, and usage covenant

Hi Olivia — great to meet on the call this morning. Follow-up with the MAP and an initial schedule for exchanging the evaluation material you requested (sample inputs, promptpack, and the probe testcases). High level: we want to provide ephemeral sandbox access + a limited dataset deliverable under the evaluation covenant below, and confirm acceptance gating so you can sign off on quality without exposing production data.

Proposed timeline (week-of):
- Mon 17 May: delivery of manifest + metadata CSV and promptpack_v1.zip (s3 presigned links / Drive folder)
- Tue 18 May: sandbox credentials + IAM roles provisioned (12-hour test window for first cut)
- Wed 19 May: BrightRetail runs acceptance probes; submit PASS/FAIL + three sample failure cases
- Thu 20 May: closure call to review acceptance, retention window, and takedown date

Usage covenant (short form):
- Purpose: evaluation only — model benchmarking and internal product testing. No redistribution or commercial use outside BrightRetail internal evaluation.
- PII: dataset redacted by BrightRetail before ingestion; if not possible, samples must be used only in the isolated sandbox and must be flagged.
- Retention: artifacts and derived outputs will be stored for up to 30 days post-acceptance unless extended in writing.
- Destruction: upon expiration or failing acceptance, BrightRetail must confirm deletion; Redwood will revoke sandbox access and remove any ephemeral caches.

Attachments: assessment_sample_manifest.csv (list of files & schemas), promptpack_v1.zip (prompt templates + readme).

Next steps: please confirm you’re good with the timeline and the two quick legal points below so we can begin provisioning: 1) limited-use clause as stated (eval-only, 30-day retention), and 2) minimal DPA excerpt for sandbox handling (we’ll provide).

Thanks — steph
